-- Spec for swap_ends: swap the first and last elements of a list in place.
-- An empty or one-element list is unchanged.

-- Pure reference: the list that swap_ends should produce from xs.
swapped_ends(xs: List[int]) -> List[int] =
  post out.len() == xs.len()
  ex swapped_ends([1, 2, 3]) == [3, 2, 1]
  ex swapped_ends([7]) == [7]
  ex swapped_ends([]) == []
  var out = copy xs
  let n = xs.len()
  if n >= 2
    let t = out[0]
    out[0] = out[n - 1]
    out[n - 1] = t
  out

-- In-place version. xs is the only mutated parameter, so it is var and the caller passes &xs.
swap_ends(var xs: List[int]) =
  post xs.len() >= 0
  let n = xs.len()
  if n >= 2
    let t = xs[0]
    xs[0] = xs[n - 1]
    xs[n - 1] = t

test_swap_ends() =
  var a = [1, 2, 3]
  swap_ends(&a)
  assert a == [3, 2, 1]
  var b = [7]
  swap_ends(&b)
  assert b == [7]
  var c: List[int] = []
  swap_ends(&c)
  assert c == []
